description: Test automation script using Cypress for login and user registration workflows in a web application.

methods.name: workspaceIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the workspace and sidebar are visible, indicating a successful login.

methods.name: loginUser
methods.description: Performs login with specified password and verifies workspace availability.

methods.name: logoutUser
methods.description: Logs out the current user and verifies redirection to login page.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Changes the user's password via API calls.
